entry.title: Survey of 443 computing students finds the impostor phenomenon, not confidence, shapes how harshly they judge AI use as cheating
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya tattaro ɗalibai 443 na karatun digiri na farko a darussan kimiyyar kwamfuta na matakin farko da na tsakiya a wata jami'a ta Amurka ya neme su su kimanta tsananin yanayi 13 na zamba ta ilimi, tare da auna amincewa da kai da yanayin jin cewa mutum bai cancanci nasarorinsa ba. Ɗalibai da suka fi nuna wannan yanayin sun fi kasancewa da yuwuwar kimanta yanayin da ya shafi AI a matsayin babbar zamba, yayin da amincewa da kai da wannan yanayin kansu suke da alaka mara kyau da juna.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan hujja ce mai amfani ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki da gaskiyar tantancewa: yadda ɗalibi yake tantance amfani da AI da tsanani na iya nuna amincewar kansa da jin cewa yana cikin al'umma, fiye da aikin kansa, abin da yake da muhimmanci wajen tsara tattaunawa da manufofin gaskiyar ilimi.

entry.title: Study of 30,000 student programming submissions finds AI-code matches rising over time, but says that alone cannot prove cheating
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya duba ayyukan dalibai 29,970 a cikin ayyukan dakin gwaje-gwaje na Python na shekarun 2021, 2023 da 2025, aka kwatanta su da amsoshi 90,000 da manyan tsarukan harshe uku na AI suka samar, ya gano cewa lambar dalibai ta kara kamanta da amsoshin AI cikin lokaci, har da ayyukan da suka wuce dukkan jarrabawowin boye. A ayyukan da aka tsayar dasu sosai, tsarukan sun hadu ne a kan kadan daga cikin tsare-tsaren lamba daidai, yayin da ayyukan da ba a takaita su ba suka ci gaba da bambanta, a lambar dalibai da ta AI duka. Masu binciken sun kammala cewa irin wannan kamantawa yana da amfani wajen bin diddigin sauyi a dukkan aji, amma ba zai iya shi kadai ya tabbatar cewa wani dalibi guda daya ya yi amfani da AI ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan gargadi ne akan amfani da kamantawar lamba a matsayin hujjar laifin dalibi daya, kuma alama ce ta sake tsara ayyukan tantancewa da gina ma'ajin amsoshi na tunani, maimakon dogara ga ganowa kadai.

arXiv (preprint, accepted Koli Calling 2026) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, accepted Koli Calling 2026)

entry.title: Wits and UJ researchers show early-warning systems for disengaged students are often tested unfairly
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Jami'ar Witwatersrand da Jami'ar Johannesburg, a cikin takarda da ba a sake duba ta ba tukuna, sun nuna cewa tsarin gargaɗin farko na ɗaliban da ke rage shiga karatu galibi ana tantance su da bayanan da a zahiri ba za su kasance a lokacin da aka yi hasashe ba, wanda ke sa tsarin ya zama kamar ya fi kyau fiye da yadda zai kasance a amfani na gaske. Ta hanyar gwada hanyoyi uku na hasashe a kan hasashe 49,329 na kowane mako daga bayanan tsarin Moodle, sun gano babu wata hanya daya da ta fi sauran a dukkan ma'auni, kuma rage matakin gargaɗi yana samun ɗalibai da yawa cikin haɗari amma yana kuma ƙara ƙararrawar ƙarya da ma'aikata dole su magance.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da muhimmanci ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 2 na Wits AHEAD kan nazarin bayanai na hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai saboda yana ba jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu wata hanya mafi gaskiya ta tantancewa, kafin dogaro da tsarin gargaɗin farko, ko zai taimaka da gaske wajen gano ɗalibai da suka rage shiga karatu cikin lokaci, ba kawai yadda yake kama a baya ba.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Generative AI access does not mean equal use, study of Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian students finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na kwatanta da aka gudanar a kan ɗaliban jami'a 42, ɗaya a kowace jami'a a China, Japan da Mongolia, ya gano cewa samun damar yin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki kaɗai ba ya nufin zai zama da amfani daidai wa daida ga karatu. Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Osaka, Jami'ar Minnesota, Jami'ar Waseda da Jami'ar Kyoto sun bayar da rahoton cewa ɗaliban China suna sauyawa tsakanin tsarin AI na cikin gida da na duniya, ɗaliban Japan galibi suna amfani da kayan aikin duniya da harshen Jafananci, yayin da ɗaliban Mongolia sukan canza zuwa Turanci idan amsoshin harshen Mongolian suka yi kama da rauni; kungiyoyin uku duk sun auna daidaito, keɓantacce, dogaro, da tasiri a kan tunaninsu mai zurfi kafin su amince da amsa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan gargaɗi ne ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu: harshe da yanayin fasaha na gida, ba samun dama kaɗai ba, su ne ke tantance ko AI mai samar da abun ciki na taimaka wa ɗalibai su koya da gaske, darasi da ya shafi tsarin jami'o'i masu harsuna da yawa, waɗanda ba Turanci ke mamaye su ba, a Kudancin Duniya.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Kyoto University framework offers universities a safer way to share student data with researchers
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Jami'ar Kyoto sun gabatar da ReLEAF, tsarin da zai bai wa jami'o'i da dandamali na koyo ta yanar gizo damar raba bayanan koyo da suke tattarawa da masu bincike na waje, tare da kare keɓancewar ɗalibai sosai. Da farko yana ba masu bincike bayanan ƙarya masu aminci don bincike, sannan daga baya a samu izinin shiga bayanan ainihi kawai bayan an amince da wata takamaiman bukatar bincike tare da cibiyar da take da bayanan. An inganta kuma an gwada wannan tsari ta hanyar zagaye da dama na aiki tare da masu kula da bayanai, masu bincike da ɗalibai a jami'o'in Japan.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da muhimmanci ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 5 na Wits AHEAD kan nazari da bayanai don tsarin ilimi saboda yawancin jami'o'i, har da na Kudancin Duniya, suna da bayanan ɗalibai masu yawa amma babu wata hanya mai aminci da aka amince da ita don raba su da masu bincike; wannan yana ba da misali mai amfani da cibiyoyi za su iya daidaitawa.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: UNESCO opens global consultation on governing AI so that education remains a common good
entry.summary:
UNESCO ta fara shawarwarin duniya, wanda zai ci gaba har zuwa Nuwamba 2026, tana gayyatar masana da masu tsara manufofi su yi sharhi kan jerin takardu na asali game da gudanar da AI a fannin ilimi. Takardar ta farko, wadda aka fitar kafin Makon Koyo na Dijital na 2026, ta bayyana hanyoyi shida da manufofin ilimi za su iya lalacewa idan ba a gudanar da yadda ake amfani da AI yadda ya kamata ba, kuma ta nuna cewa ilimi ya kamata ya ci gaba da kasancewa mallakar kowa, maimakon a bar gudanarwarsa ga masu samar da AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Shawarwarin nan za su tsara jagorar UNESCO mai zuwa ga ma'aikatu da jami'o'i, wanda ke mai da shi muhimmin abin tunani ga Ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai riƙon amana, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, musamman ga cibiyoyi a Kudancin Duniya da ba su da ƙarfin tsara tsarin gudanar da AI nasu.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body, consultation paper

entry.title: Simple digital markers could flag at-risk first-year computer science students by week five, Southern African study finds
entry.summary:
Bayan nazarin ɗalibai na shekara ta farko a fannin kimiyyar kwamfuta a rukunin shekaru huɗu daban-daban a jami'ar gwamnati mai girma a Kudu da Hamadar Sahara, masu bincike sun gano cewa auna ƙwazon ilimin ɗalibi, tare da bayanan asali masu sauƙi da kuma ko ɗalibin ya taɓa shiga tsarin koyo na kan layi na darasin ko bai yi ba, ya iya gane kaso 87 cikin ɗari na ɗalibai da suka ƙare da fadi. Marubutan sun ce tsarin ya yi sauƙi sosai har za a iya amfani da shi a matsayin tsarin gargaɗi da wuri tun daga mako na biyar na zangon karatu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Irin wannan kayan aikin gargaɗi da wuri mai sauƙi, wanda ba ya buƙatar bayanai masu yawa, ya dace da jami'o'in da ba su da tsarin bayanai mai girma, kuma yana ƙara ƙarfin Ginshiƙi na Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai na hasashe domin nasarar ɗalibai a wuraren da ba su da albarkatu masu yawa.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Nigerian study finds male pre-service STEM teachers report higher AI literacy than female peers
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya tattara ɗalibai 541 da ke horo domin zama malaman STEM a Jami'ar Jihar Lagos, wanda aka buga a mujallar STEM Education, ya gano cewa ɗalibai sun kimanta kansu da sanin AI mai yawan gaske, kuma fahimtar AI ta yi tasiri sosai kan yadda za su yi amfani da ita wajen koyarwa. Binciken ya kuma gano banbanci mai muhimmanci tsakanin jinsi, inda ɗalibai maza suka kimanta kansu da sanin AI fiye da 'yan matan da suka shiga binciken.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan banbanci yana da muhimmanci ga shirye-shiryen horar da malamai a ko'ina a Kudancin Duniya da suke son ganin sanin AI ya bazu daidai tsakanin sabon zamanin malaman STEM, lamarin da ke tsakiyar Ginshiƙi na 3 na Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a horar da malamai na STEM.

STEM Education (AIMS Press) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Universities in Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom take different paths to redesign teaching for AI

category.term: Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom

entry.summary:
The Korea Times ta ba da rahoton cewa jami'o'in Koriya sun ƴara wurare sama da 4,000 a fannonin AI da masana'antar semiconductor tun 2024, kuma neman shiga sashin AI a jami'o'i manya ashirin ya ƴaru da kashi 16 cikin ɗari a bana, yayin da gwamnati ta tilasta iyakance sabbin wurare na fasaha ta zamani zuwa 434 don shekarar 2027 saboda rashin isassun ma'aikata da kayan aiki. Rahoton ya kuma kwatanta wannan bunƴasa da Jami'ar Fasaha ta Nanyang da ke Singapore, wadda ke shirin haɗa AI cikin kashi 40 na darussanta na digiri na farko nan da shekara 2030, da King's College London da London School of Economics, wadanda ke sake tsara jarrabawa kuma suna ba ɗalibai da ma'aikata izinin yin amfani da kayan aikin AI maimakon komawa jarrabawar rubutun hannu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, kwatancen ya nuna martani biyu daban-daban ga matsin lamba iri ɗaya, ko dai ƴara ikon AI ko sake tsara abin da kuma yadda ake tantance ɗalibai, zaɓi da jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu suke yi la'akari da shi a lokaci guda.

The Korea Times · Established national press, first instalment of a three-part series

entry.title: Study proposes voice-based AI interviews as a richer alternative to end-of-semester course surveys
entry.summary:
Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Fasaha ta Munich da MIT Sloan School of Management sun ba da shawarar maye gurbin tambayoyin rubutu na ƴarshen zangon karatu da tattaunawa mai tsari da wakilin AI mai amfani da murya ke gudanarwa, wanda zai iya yin tambayoyin bibiya wanda fom na rubutu ba zai iya yi ba. Gwajin fasaha a Jami'ar Fasaha ta Munich ya nuna cewa tattaunawar AI ta waya mai yiwuwa ce, kuma marubutan yanzu suna shirin gudanar da cikakken bincike a fagen aiki a cikin darasi na MIT Sloan mai ɗalibai kusan 60, suna kimanta ra'ayoyin bisa ga tsayuwa, wadatar jigo, sautin ginawa da zurfin yanayi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, binciken ya nuna amfani mai amfani na AI ta tattaunawa a cikin koyarwa: canza raunin martani mai ƴan amsa zuwa wanda ya ƴunƴunta sosai har malamai da cibiyoyi za su ɗauki mataki a kai.

Technical University of Munich and the MIT Sloan School of Management, posted to arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Eduvos academic leader tells CNBC Africa that equal access to AI, not only AI literacy, will decide graduate employability
entry.summary:
A taron koli na AI na CNBC Africa, wata shugabar ilimi daga Eduvos, cibiyar ilimi mai zaman kanta, ta ce jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu ba za su iya ƴin jira ba don yanke shawara kan abin da AI ke nufi ga koyarwa da ɗalibai, kuma sanin AI, wato sanin lokacin dogaro da AI da lokacin yin tunani da kanka, yanzu yana da muhimmanci kamar ƴan ilimin asali. Shugabar ta yi gargaɗi cewa samun AI ba samun digiri kawai ba ne: idan ba a samar da na'urori, taimakon dijital da kayayyakin more rayuwa ga ɗalibai daga yankuna marasa galihu ba, AI na iya ƴara rashin daidaito a tsakanin ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu suke shiga kasuwar aiki, maimakon rage shi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na ƴarfin ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauyen adalci, wannan hira tunatarwa ce cewa shirin AI a manyan makarantun Afirka ta Kudu ya dogara da samun dama daidai ga kayan aiki da kayayyakin more rayuwa, kamar yadda ya dogara da koyar da ƴwarewar AI.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Seven-country study finds universities at very different stages of AI readiness
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da aka gudanar a kasashe bakwai daga WISE da Institute of International Education ya gano cewa jami'o'i suna matakai daban-daban na shirye-shiryen AI mai samar da abun ciki, inda manufofi, halin dalibai da kayayyakin more rayuwa duk ba su daidaita ba. A wata jami'a mai zaman kanta a Ghana, kashi 64 na malamai sun ce suna da tsayayyar manufar AI, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 27 a jami'ar bincike ta gwamnati, duk da cewa kashi 89 na malaman da aka bincika sun taba amfani da AI da kansu. Masu binciken sun yi gargadi cewa, saboda manyan tsare-tsaren AI suna koyo ne mafi yawa daga Turanci da wasu harsuna masu karfi, cibiyoyin Afirka da na Kudancin Duniya wasu suna cikin hadarin zama masu amfani da AI kawai, ba masu ginawa ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai dogaro da kai, da'a, adalci da manufofi, binciken ya nuna cewa gibin shiryawa tsakanin cibiyoyi, ba tsakanin kasashe kadai ba, na iya ƴara maimakon rage rashin daidaito a yadda manyan makarantu suke amfani da AI.

WISE and the Institute of International Education (IIE), reported by University World News · Established higher education press, reporting a WISE/IIE policy brief

entry.title: Dutch minister calls AI-written theses 'fraud', universities say detection scores cannot prove it
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da gidan talabijin na Holland ya yi kan daruruwan kundin digiri na biyu a jami'o'i goma sha biyu ya gano cewa, a cikin kowane biyar, kusan daya daga ciki, chatbots kamar ChatGPT, Claude ko Gemini sun rubuta rubutu fiye da dalibin da kansa. Ministar Ilimi, Rianne Letschert, ta kira wannan zamba, amma kungiyar da ke wakiltar jami'o'in Holland, Universiteiten van Nederland, ta ce makin ganowa shi kadai ba zai iya tabbatar da zamba ba, kuma tambayar da ta dace ita ce yadda ake tsara jarrabawa. Jami'o'in Delft, Utrecht da Leiden kowanne ya hana ko kayyade amfani da kayan aikin gano AI kan ayyukan dalibai, suna cewa ba abin dogaro ba ne.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, wannan rigima ta nuna yadda takaddamar amincin ilimi za ta iya zama ta siyasa cikin sauri idan minista ya shiga ciki, kuma dalilin da ya sa kungiyar take kwadaitar da sake tsara jarrabawa maimakon dogaro da software na ganowa.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Russell Group students say they are taught little about AI, Bett UK survey finds
entry.summary:
Bincike na Bett UK kan daliban digiri na farko sama da 1,000 a Birtaniya ya gano cewa kashi 77 na daliban jami'o'in Russell Group na cewa ba a koya musu komai ko kadan ba game da AI, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 64 a jami'o'in post-1992. Binciken ya kuma gano cewa kashi 78 na dalibai za su so digiri da fasaha ta keɓance musamman wanda zai dauki lokaci kadan, yayin da kashi 34 kacal ne suka ji cewa jami'arsu ta gaskata musu game da ainihin makomar aiki bayan kammala karatu. Russell Group ta ce membobinta na sake tsara tsarin karatu da ka'idojin jarrabawa sakamakon haka.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, gano cewa jami'o'in da suka fi mayar da hankali kan bincike suna koyar da fasahar AI kasa da sauran cibiyoyi ya haifar da tambaya ta adalci kai tsaye: wadanne daliban kammala karatu ne za su shiga kasuwar aiki wadda AI ta canza da shiri sosai.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: New framework guides statistics and data science educators on teaching responsible generative AI use
entry.summary:
Wata tawagar malaman ilmin lissafi da kimiyyar bayanai sun fitar da tsarin da ya kunshi sashe hudu, fahimta, bunkasa, rahoto, da tsaro, domin jagorantar yadda malamai za su koyar wa dalibai amfani da kayan AI mai samar da abun ciki cikin gaskiya wajen rubutun lambobi da nazarin kididdiga. An inganta shi ta hanyar tarukan horo da ra'ayin dalibai, kuma an rigaya an yi amfani da shi a cikin shirin MOOC da koyarwar manyan makarantu na digiri na farko da na biyu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazari a ilmin STEM da horar da malamai, na bukatar tsarin da ya shirya don aji, ba kawai maganganun manufofi ba; wannan yana baiwa Wits AHEAD misali mai aiki na koyar da iya amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a cikin ilimin kididdiga.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New tool scrambles assignment images so AI reading systems fail, but people can still read them
entry.summary:
Masu bincike sun gina AIRRI, kayan aiki da ke canza yadda hotunan ayyukan da aka buga suke kama ta hanyar sauya tazara, haske, da hayaniyar hoto tare da hare-haren adawa, domin kayan OCR da chatbot na AI su wahala wajen rubuta su sake yayin da mutum har yanzu zai iya karanta su daidai. Lokacin da aka gwada shi a kan tsarin karatu uku, hari mai karfi ya kara yawan kurakuran haruffa na tsari daya daga kashi 2.3 cikin dari zuwa kashi 100 cikin dari, sannan kuma kurakuran kalmomi na tsari na biyu daga kashi 24.9 cikin dari zuwa kashi 96.7 cikin dari. Tawagar ta kuma fitar da bayanan ayyukan manyan makarantu domin gwada hanyar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu: koyarwa, tantancewa, da gaskiya, na bukatar kariya da take aiki a matakin aikin da kansa; Wits AHEAD na lura da kayan aiki irin wannan domin ganin ko za a iya gina gaskiya a cikin kayan karatu maimakon bin ta bayan ta faru.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New framework argues the cost of AI essay-marking systems should be measured against trustworthy scores, not efficiency alone
entry.summary:
Sabon takarda ya gabatar da tsarin “Ɣantacciyar Aunawa Mai La'akari da Kuɗi” don tsarin bada maki na rubutu ta atomatik, yana cewa kuɗin kwamfuta na bada maki ta AI galibi ana ɗauka kamar matsalar inganci ta fasaha ne kawai, alhali a gaskiya zabi ne na Ɣantacciyar aunawa. Tsarin ya bayyana “kuɗin kowace maki mai tabbaci” wanda kawai ke kwatanta tsarin bada maki a tsakanin Ɣantacciya da suka cika mafarin Ɣanci na aunawa mai gaskiya, kuma yana ɗaukar Ɣancin gudanarwa da sa ido na cibiya a matsayin iyaka kan waɗanda za a iya amfani da su, ba kuɗin da za a rage ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiķin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, tsarin yana baiwa jami'o'in da suke tunanin yin amfani da bada maki da taimakon AI hanya ta zahiri don tambaya ko tsarin mai rahusa yana samar da maki na gaskiya ne, maimakon yin shari'a kan kayan tantancewa ta atomatik kawai da sauri da kuɗi.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Study of a South African university finds online “participation profiles” mostly track how long a learner is observed, not how engaged they are
entry.summary:
Bayan binciken bayanai 16,448 na ɗalibi-darasi daga ɗalibai 4,599 a cikin darussa 152 a jami'ar gwamnati ta Afirka ta Kudu, masu bincike sun gwada hanyoyin awo takwas da ake amfani da su akai-akai na “shiga” ta yanar gizo, suka gano cewa dukkansu sun nuna tsawon lokacin da aka kalli ɗalibin a cikin darasin fiye da yadda ɗalibin ya shiga ainihi. Bayan daidaita wannan sakamakon, ƴan hanyoyin awo kaɗan har yanzu sun kasa ɗalibai zuwa fasali mai fannoni biyu da fasali mai fannoni huɗu mai zurfi, amma da tabbaci mai matsakaici ne kawai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiķin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai na hasashe don samun nasarar ɗalibai, gano wannan gargaɗi ne kai tsaye ga tsarin gargaɗi da wuri da riķe ɗalibai da aka gina kan bayanan Afirka ta Kudu: sai an yi la'akari da tsawon lokacin da ake bin ɗalibi, fasalin da ake kira “ba ya shiga” zai iya kasancewa na ɗalibin da an kalla na ɗan lokaci kaɗan ne kawai, ba wanda yake cikin haɗari da gaske ba.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Study finds students who earn the same grade can have done very different amounts of their own thinking with AI help
entry.summary:
Ta hanyar bincika tattaunawa 150 da aka rubuta tsakanin ɗalibai da kayan aikin AI mai samar da abun ciki, sabon bincike ya gano cewa ɗalibai da suke jagorantar AI, suke haɗa sakamakonta cikin zurfin tunani, kuma suke tantance ta da kyau, za su iya samun maki ɗaya da ɗalibai da suka bar AI ta yi yawancin tunani a madadinsu, don haka maki na ķarshe shi kaɗai ba ya nuna yawan aikin da ainihi na ɗalibin ne. Marubucin ya kira wannan gibin “mallakar ilimi” kuma ya ce bada maki akan sakamako kawai na iya ba da lada ga matakan shigar ɗalibi daban-daban da maki iri ɗaya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiķin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, binciken ya ķarfafa hujja ta tantancewa da take kuma duba yadda ɗalibi ya yi amfani da AI yayin aikin, ba sakamakon ķarshe kawai ba, domin maki biyu iri ɗaya na iya ɗoye koyo mabambanta sosai.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Wits tells top applicants AI should make graduates indispensable, not just employable
entry.summary:
Ɗaliban da suka fi 200 wadanda suka yi kyau a jarabawar kammala sakandare, daga jihar Gauteng da wasu yankuna, sun halarci Taron Masu Neman Shiga Mafi Kyau na Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar Wits, inda tsohon ɗalibin Wits, Dr Craig Wing, ya gabatar da jawabin baƙon babban taron kan AI da makomar duniyar aiki. Wani Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'a, Farfesa Garth Stevens, ya shaida wa ɗaliban cewa jami'a nauyi ne, ba hanyar samun aiki kawai ba, kuma Wits na so ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu su zama ba wadanda za a iya aiki da su kawai ba, su zama wadanda ba za a iya rasa su ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, taron ya nuna cewa Jami'ar da kanta tana shirya ɗaliban sabbi don kasuwar aiki wadda AI ta sake fasalta, tun daga ranar farko da suka hadu da Wits, maimakon jira batun samun aikin yi sai bayan kammala karatu.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Study finds AI grading tools miss most student misconceptions despite accurate scores
entry.summary:
Wani sabon bincike ya binciki ko manyan abubuwan koyon na'ura na AI da ke yiwa ayyukan rubutu na buɗaɗɗe maki a manyan makarantu suna da amfani kamar yadda makin su na daidaito ke nuna. Ta hanyar bincika amsoshin ɗalibai 3,041 kan tambayoyi 50 na kimiyyar kwamfuta na buɗaɗɗe, waɗanda malamai ɗan'adam da kuma manyan abubuwan koyon na'ura na AI na kasuwanci guda uku suka yi maki, masu binciken sun gano cewa ra'ayin da AI ta bayar ya gano kurakuran fahimtar ɗalibai a kashi 5 zuwa 7 cikin ɗari ne kawai, idan an kwatanta da kashi 15 zuwa 31 cikin ɗari na malamai ɗan'adam, kuma ra'ayin AI ya ci gaba da kasancewa mai kyau koyaushe ba tare da la'akari da inganci amsar ba. Binciken ya kuma gano cewa ƙananan makin rubric da AI ta samar sun yi kama da juna sosai har suka kasa bayar da bayanan tantancewa masu zaman kansu masu amfani.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, gano cewa bada maki ta AI na iya zama kamar daidai ne alhali tana rasa yawancin kurakuran tunani masu muhimmanci ga koyarwa, gargaɗi ne na kada a maye gurbin hukuncin tantancewa na malami da bada maki ta atomatik.

arXiv (preprint) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: California requires its public colleges to set AI procurement and training standards
entry.summary:
Jihar California ta sanya hannu kan dokar Assembly Bill 2392 (AB 2392), wadda ta wajabta wa tsarin California Community Colleges da California State University su hada kai domin kafa kwamitin aiki wanda zai bayar da shawarwari kan ka'idojin sayayya da horar da ma'aikata da dalibai kan tsarin AI mai samar da abun ciki, inda ake sa ran shawarwarin su kammala kafin Janairun 2028. Dokar da aka sanya hannu a kanta a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026 a matsayin Chapter 855 na Statutes of 2026, tana kuma bukatar tsarin biyu su duba horon AI akalla sau daya a shekara, su kuma kai rahoto ga majalisar dokokin jihar cikin kwanaki 60 bayan sa hannu kan duk wata yarjejeniyar AI mai samar da abun ciki da ta shafi dukkan tsarin.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga sashin Wits AHEAD na AI mai dogaro da kai, da'a, adalci da manufofi, matakin da California ta dauka na rubuta ka'idojin sayayya na gwamnati da horarwa a cikin doka, maimakon barin kowace jami'a ta yanke shawararta kan AI mai samar da abun ciki, misali ne daga Arewacin Duniya na gudanar da AI a matakin tsarin gaba daya, wani abu da ake kuma kwadaitar da tsarin manyan makarantu na Kudancin Duniya su gina.

California State Legislature · State legislation

entry.title: University of Johannesburg vice-chancellor: Africa needs AI governance beyond regulation
entry.summary:
A wata hira ta yau da kullum da CNBC Africa, mataimakin shugaban University of Johannesburg, Farfesa Letlhokwa Mpedi, ya tattauna da babban editan tashar, Godfrey Mutizwa, kan abin da ake buƙata domin gudanar da AI a Afirka fiye da ƴan dokokin ƙa'ida kaɗai. Tattaunawar ta taɓo rawar da jami'o'i da masu tsara manufofi su taka wajen tsara ci gaban AI a nahiyar, maimakon kawai amsa dokokin da wasu suka tsara a wani wuri.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗa'a, gudanarwa, adalci da manufofi, mataimakin shugaban jami'a a Afirka ta Kudu da yake kan mulki yana nuna goyon baya ga gudanar da AI ƴar Afirka, wannan yana danganta kai tsaye da manufar Wits AHEAD ta gina ƙwarewar Afirka don tsara sharuɗɗan ci gaban AI, maimakon kawai bin tsare-tsaren da wasu suka ƙera a wani wuri.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Joining up AI across recruitment, retention and alumni relations can close graduation gaps, if it is governed well
entry.summary:
A rubutunsa a cikin University World News, darektan aikin IREX, Cameron Mirza, ya ce ya kamata jami'o'i su ɗauki shigar da ɗalibai, riƙe su, da alaƙa da tsofaffin ɗalibai a matsayin wani zagaye guda ɗaya da aka haɗa kuma AI ke taimakawa, maimakon tsarurruka daban daban masu bayanai daban daban. Ya kawo misalin shirin chatbot da nazarin hasashe na Georgia State University, wanda ake yabawa da rage "summer melt" da kusan kashi 21, da kuma taimaka wa ɗalibai Bakaken fata, 'yan Hispanic, na farkon iyali, da masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga su kammala karatu a adadin da ya yi daidai ko ya zarce na sauran ɗalibai, yana mai gargaɗi cewa samfuran da aka horar da su a kan tsoffin bayanai na iya kuma ƙara tabbatar da rashin adalci da ake son gyarawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin hasashe domin nasarar ɗalibai, wannan rubutu tunatarwa ce mai amfani cewa kayan aikin gargaɗi da wuri da riƙe ɗalibai suna rufe gibin rashin daidaito ne kawai idan aka haɗa su da kulawar ɗan'adam da gwajin son zuciya, wannan shi ne tambayar gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD take yi wa duk wani kayan aiki na nazari da take ba da shawarar amfani da shi.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary by a sector practitioner)

entry.title: Wits researchers argue Africa must set its own AI research agenda, not just apply others' tools
entry.summary:
Masana kimiyyar kwamfuta biyu na University of the Witwatersrand, Benjamin Rosman da Steve James, wadanda ke jagorantar Robotics, Autonomous Intelligence and Learning (RAIL) Lab tare, sun ce ya kamata Afirka ta jagoranci bincike kan AI maimakon amfani da kayan aikin da aka kera a wani wuri dabam. Sun yi nuni da Deep Learning Indaba, wadda yanzu ita ce babbar makarantar bazara ta AI mafi girma a duniya, wadda ta jawo hankalin mahalarta 1,300 a taron bara da aka yi a Kigali, kuma take gudanar da shirinta na IndabaX a kasashe 48 daga cikin 54 na Afirka a wannan shekarar, tare da sabuwar cibiyar Wits ta Machine Intelligence and Neural Discovery (MIND) Institute, wadda ta haɗa ƙwararru kusan 65 daga fannonin kimiyyar kwamfuta, ilimin kwakwalwa, ilimin halayyar ɗan'adam da manufofi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, gargaɗin da ke cewa kada Afirka ta zama kawai "wurin da wasu mutane ke yin bincike" yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da manufar Wits AHEAD ta kafa ƙwarewar da Afirkawa ke jagoranta wajen tsara tambayoyin bincike na AI, ba kawai amfani da kayan aikin AI da aka kera a wani wuri dabam ba.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Study of students in China, Japan and Mongolia finds access to generative AI does not guarantee it is useful for learning
entry.summary:
Wata takarda bincike da ta yi nazari a kan ɗaliban digiri na farko 42 a jami'a guda a kowanne daga cikin China, Japan da Mongolia ta gano cewa yadda ɗalibai ke samun AI mai samar da abun ciki, ko ta hanyar kai tsaye, ta dandamalin duniya, ko ta sauya harshe, ke tantance ko tana da amfani a gare su da gaske, ba kawai ko za su iya samun ta ba. Misali, ɗaliban Mongolia sun saba sauyawa zuwa Turanci a duk sa'ad da amsoshin harshen Mongolian suka gaza, yayin da dukkan ƙungiyoyi ukun suka yi la'akari da daidaito, sirri, dogaro, da tasirin kayan aikin a kan tunaninsu mai zurfi. Marubutan, Ming Li, Qin Xie, Ariunaa Enkhtur, Lilan Chen da Fei Cheng, sun kammala cewa samun fasaha kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da amfani daidai a fannin ilimi a cikin saitunan harshe da fasaha daban daban.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, binciken da ya nuna cewa harshe da yanayin fasaha na gida, ba haɗin kai kaɗai ba, ke tantance ko AI mai samar da abun ciki tana taimaka wa ɗalibai koyo da gaske, gargaɗi ne da Wits AHEAD take amfani da shi daidai wa daida ga kayan aikin AI masu rinjayen Turanci da ake amfani da su a jami'o'i masu harsuna da yawa na Kudancin Afirka.

arXiv (working paper) · Working paper (preprint, not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: South African minister tells universities to move from AI debate to decisions on teaching and research
entry.summary:
A jawabinsa a Taron Manyan Makarantu na Jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu karo na hudu a ranar 7 ga Oktoba, 2026, Ministan Manyan Makarantu da Horarwa, Buti Manamela, ya shaida wa jami'o'i cewa AI yana ƙara muhimmancin aikinsu na asali, wato koyar da tunani mai zurfi da ɗaukar nauyin sahihancin ilimi, maimakon rage shi, domin tsarin AI na iya fitar da bayanai masu ƙarfin gwiwa ba tare da tabbatar da gaskiyarsu ba. Ya ce tambayar gaskiya ta wuce ko ɗalibai suna amfani da AI wajen ayyukansu, ta kai ga wanda ke ƙirƙirar fasahar, harsuna da gogewar wane ne take wakilta, wanda ke sarrafa kayan aikinta, da wanda ke amfana da ita. Ya kuma yi kira ga fannonin ɗan'adam da ilimin zamantakewa su yi aiki tare da injiniyanci da kimiyyar halitta kan son zuciya, iko da tasirin aiki da ke tattare da fasahar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ministan gwamnati yana kafa manufa bayyananniya kan koyarwa, tantancewa da ƙarfin bincike maimakon muhawara ta gaba ɗaya, yana ba jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu wata hujja ta fili don aiwatarwa.

South African Government News Agency (SAnews) · National government news agency

entry.title: UNESCO study finds 87% of Latin American and Caribbean universities already use AI, but only 26% have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Wata takarda bincike ta UNESCO IESALC tare da UNU-IAS, wadda ta yi nazari a kan cibiyoyin manyan makarantu 200 a cikin ƙasashe 19 na Latin Amurka da Caribbean tsakanin Agusta zuwa Oktoba na 2025, ta gano cewa kashi 87 cikin ɗari na amfani da AI a kalla a wani fanni guda, inda koyarwa da koyo (kashi 74) da bincike (kashi 57) suka jagoranta, amma kashi 26 ne kawai suke da manufar AI ta hukuma, kuma kashi 55 ba su da wata kasafin kuɗi na AI ko kaɗan. Yaɗuwa da gudanarwa duk suna bin irin cibiyar sosai: kashi 84 na jami'o'in masu zaman kansu marasa riba suna amfani da AI idan aka kwatanta da kashi 68 na jami'o'in gwamnati, kuma kashi 17 na jami'o'in gwamnati sun ba da rahoton rashin horar da ma'aikata ko kaɗan, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 3 na jami'o'in masu zaman kansu marasa riba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, binciken da ya nuna cewa amfani da AI ya yaɗu sosai yayin da gudanarwar hukuma ta yi nisa a baya, kuma ba daidai ba tsakanin cibiyoyin gwamnati da na masu zaman kansu, yana nuna gibin gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD take gani a faɗin Kudancin Duniya.

UNESCO IESALC and UNU-IAS, reported by Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO/UNU-IAS working paper

entry.title: UTeach survey finds STEM teacher-training staff cautiously optimistic about AI but wary of integrity and bias risks
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya ƙunshi ma'aikata 57 na koyarwa, gudanarwa da sauran ma'aikata daga shirye-shirye 31 na horar da malaman STEM na sakandare a kwalejoji da jami'o'i 54 na Amurka, ya gano cewa kashi 77 cikin ɗari sun yarda cewa AI na da yuwuwar yin tasiri mai kyau a kan aikinsu, yayin da kashi 61 cikin ɗari suka bayyana kansu a matsayin masu amfani da AI tun da wuri. Kashi 63 cikin ɗari na ci gaba da damuwa kan ƙalubale, musamman gaskiyar ilimi (kashi 42) da son zuciya na ɗa'a (kashi 21), yayin da kashi 70 cikin ɗari suka nuna buƙatar horo mai zurfi; kashi 79 cikin ɗari na malaman suna riga suna haɗa AI a cikin karatunsu, galibi don tsara darussa da ƙirƙirar tantancewa, maimakon bincike mai yawan bayanai a fannin STEM.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, gibin da ke tsakanin malaman da ke gwada AI tun yanzu da tsarin bincike na bai ɗaya da suke cewa ba su da shi, shi ne irin jagoran da shirye-shiryen horar da malamai a Kudancin Duniya za su buƙaci su ma.

The UTeach Institute, The University of Texas at Austin · University research institute report

entry.title: Systematic review finds no existing framework yet addresses the ethical and instructional challenges of AI in STEM teaching
entry.summary:
Wani bincike mai tsari da masu bincike daga Wentworth Institute of Technology da University of New Haven suka gudanar ya duba tsare-tsaren koyarwa da aka kafa kamar TPACK, SAMR, ADDIE da Universal Design for Learning, dangane da samfuran ilimin AI da ƙa'idojin AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, domin ganin yadda suke tallafa wa malaman STEM wajen koyarwa. Binciken ya gano cewa babu ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan tsare-tsaren da ya magance ƙalubalen sana'a, ɗa'a da koyarwa na amfani da AI a fannin STEM, kuma cewa amfani da kayan aikin AI yana tafiya gaba da jagorar koyarwa mai tsari, abin da ke haifar da ayyuka da kayan aiki ke tuƙa maimakon tsarin da ke tuƙa su.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, binciken da ya nuna cewa babu tsarin koyarwa da ya magance ƙalubalen ɗa'a da koyarwa na AI yana ƙarfafa hujjar aikin ƙungiyar kan haɗa AI mai ɗaukar nauyi musamman a fannin STEM.

American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE), North East Section Conference · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: More universities end Turnitin contracts as concerns mount
entry.summary:
Jaridar Times Higher Education ta ba da rahoton cewa Jami'ar Newcastle da Jami'ar Westminster sun haɗu da Jami'ar Southampton wajen soke yarjejeniyoyinsu da kamfanin gano satar ilimi, Turnitin, bayan kamfanin ya gabatar da canje-canjen lasisi da za su iya ba da damar yin amfani da aikin ɗalibai don horar da kayan aikin AI. Newcastle ta ambaci wannan sharaɗin bayanai kai tsaye; Westminster ta ce na'urar binciken satar ilimi ta Turnitin 'bata da tasiri sosai' wajen gano rubutun da AI ta rubuta, kuma na'urar gano AI tasu na ɗauke da 'haɗarin da aka sani na kuskuren tantancewa'. Southampton kaɗai ta biya Turnitin fam 87,621 a shekara guda, daga cikin ɗalibai sama da 17,000 na digiri na farko da 8,000 na gaba da digiri.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan takaddama ta nuna jami'o'i suna farawa auna gudanarwar bayanai da ainihin inganci na kayan aikin gano AI da tsadar su, maimakon ɗaukar yarjejeniyar gano satar ilimi a matsayin wajibi da ba za a canza shi ba.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Prepare students for post-graduation AI judgement challenges
entry.summary:
Jaridar University World News ta ce martanin manyan makarantu ga AI mai samar da abun ciki yana tsayawa da wuri, wato a lokacin kammala karatu, alhali ainihin jarrabawar hukuncin sana'a yakan zo bayan haka. Ta ambaci gwajin filin da aka yi rajista a gaba a shekarar 2026 a mujallar Organization Science, inda mashawarta 758 na Boston Consulting Group suka gudanar da ayyuka na gaskiya tare da ko ba tare da mataimaki na AI mai samar da abun ciki ba. A galibin ayyukan, ƙungiyar da ta yi amfani da AI ta yi aiki da sauri kuma a matakin da ya fi girma, amma a wani tsarin ayyuka guda da ya fita kaɗan daga iyawar na'urar, kashi 70.6 cikin ɗari kawai na mashawarta da suka yi amfani da AI ne suka samu amsa daidai, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 84.5 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka yi aiki ba tare da taimako ba, kuma masu tantancewa da ba su san amsar ba sun ɗauki shawarwarin da ba daidai ba na AI a matsayin masu ƙarfin gaskatawa kamar su na daidai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ganowar cewa aikin AI mai kuskure amma mai tsaron gaba na iya zama mai ƙarfin gaskatawa kamar aikin daidai, ya nuna cewa hukuncin sana'a, ba ƙwarewar AI kaɗai ba, shi ne ƙwarewar da ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu suke bukata kafin su shiga kasuwar aikin yi.

University World News · Established higher education press, commentary citing a peer-reviewed field experiment

entry.title: UNESCO and Codemao's AI coding drive reaches more African classrooms
entry.summary:
UNESCO da dandalin rubutun lambobin kwamfuta na China, Codemao, sun ce shirin su na hadin gwiwa na koyar wa matasa rubutun lambobin kwamfuta na ci gaba da fadada a Afirka. Mataki na biyu, wanda zai kai har zuwa 2030, ya horar da malamai 200 a Jamhuriyar Congo, Kenya, Namibia da Thailand, kashi 45 cikin dari daga cikinsu mata ne, kuma an baiwa Kenya na'urorin tablet 200 ga makarantun sakandare na junior 20.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a cikin ilimin STEM da horar da malamai, wannan shiri yana nuna wata hanya ta ginawa malamai iyawar AI da rubutun lambobin kwamfuta a Kudancin Duniya, tare da mayar da hankali kan mata.

Xinhua (New China TV) · Major international news agency, video report

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds AI chatbot use split with student learning outcomes
entry.summary:
Jarabawar PISA 2025 ta OECD, wacce ita ce ta farko da ta duba yadda daliban shekara 15 suke amfani da AI, ta tambayi dalibai sama da 760,000 a kasashe 91. Ta gano cewa dogaro da yawa kan chatbot na AI wajen rubuta aikin gida yana da alaka da maki kasa a kimiyya, yayin da amfani matsakaici kuma da jagora ke nuna sakamako daban kuma mai kyau; makin karatu da lissafi su ma sun fadi sosai a kasashen OECD cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan alama ce ta farko ta halayen da daliban za su kawo jami'a, da abin da jami'a za ta bukaci koyarwa da tantancewa.

OECD (via Newsweek) · Intergovernmental body's flagship international assessment, reported by established press

entry.title: Understanding ethical dimensions of AI in higher education: insights from faculty members and students
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya yi amfani da hade-haden hanyoyi ya tambayi dalibai 971 da ma'aikatan jami'a 135, sannan ya yi hira da dalibai 23 da malamai 14, kan ɗa'ar AI a manyan makarantu. Kungiyoyin biyu sun amince gaba daya kan yin amfani da AI yadda ya dace, amma ra'ayinsu ya bambanta: malamai sun jaddada ka'idojin ɗa'a amma sun ce jami'o'insu ba su da jagororin tsari, yayin da dalibai suka ga AI yana da amfani ga koyo amma ba su tabbata inda nauyinsu na ɗa'a ya tsaya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, shawarwarin binciken, horar da ma'aikata, darussan ɗa'a na musamman, da jagororin jami'a bayyanannu, suna ba da jerin abubuwan aiki ga cibiyoyin da ba su da manufar ɗa'ar AI ta tsari tukuna.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: From AI literacy to action: South Africa charts a path forward for teacher education
entry.summary:
Ma'aikatar Ilimi Mai Zurfi da Horo ta Afirka ta Kudu da Commonwealth of Learning sun shirya taron karo-karo na kwanaki biyu kan AI a horar da malamai, a sashen Future Africa na Jami'ar Pretoria. Malamai, masu tsara manufofi, da shugabannin tsarin ilimi sun amince da wata hanyar manufofin kasa mai sauki canzawa kuma ta tushen ka'idoji, kuma sun kafa kungiyar aiki ta kasa, inda sakamakon zai taimaka wajen bitar da ake yi na bukatun mafi karanci na cancantar horar da malamai, wadda mahalarta suka bayyana cewa a yanzu bata ambaci komai kan AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazari a kimiyyar STEM da horar da malamai, wannan ya nuna tsari bayyananne, karkashin jagorancin gwamnati, wanda yake mayar da ilimin AI zuwa manufar kasa kan cancanta a tsarin horar da malamai na Afirka ta Kudu.

Commonwealth of Learning · Intergovernmental organisation report on a national government workshop

entry.title: Supporting cost-effective AI adoption in education
entry.summary:
Bankin Duniya ya fitar da wata takarda ta bincike, Costing AI Use in Education in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, tare da rubutun blog da ke bayyana yadda ma'aikatun ilimi za su tsara kasafin kudin AI. Ta ba da shawarar farawa da kayan aiki da za su taimaka wa malamai, kamar shirya darasi da bayar da ra'ayi, maimakon fara amfani da su ga dalibai duka a lokaci guda, kuma a kwatanta kudin AI da kudin da ake kashewa yanzu wajen fadada koyarwar gargajiya, da kuma amfani da na'urori da hanyoyin sadarwar waya da ake da su a makarantu. Bankin Duniya ya kiyasta cewa cimma burin ci gaba mai dorewa na ilimi a Kudancin Hamadar Sahara zai bukaci dalar Amurka biliyan 6.4 kowace shekara don malaman firamare da biliyan 38.7 kowace shekara don malaman sakandare nan da shekarar 2030, in ba haka ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan nazari da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, wannan rahoto yana baiwa ma'aikatun ilimi da cibiyoyi a Kudancin Duniya wani tsari bayyananne mai kudin da aka kiyasta na yanke shawarar inda kashe kudin AI a ilimi zai fi amfani.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body blog, summarising a World Bank working paper

entry.title: Grappling with "homework scams", US universities shun AI detectors
entry.summary:
Rahoton AFP da eNCA ta ɗauko ya bayyana yadda Yale, Cornell da Jami'ar Wisconsin-Madison ke hana ko kawar da ma'aikatansu daga amfani da software na gano AI a matsayin shaidar zamba, bayan da bincike ya gano cewa waɗannan kayan aiki ba su da aminci kuma suna yawan yi wa marasa laifi zargi, har da waɗanda Ingilishi ba yarensu na asali ba ne. Wata malama ta ilmin halittu a Wisconsin-Madison, wadda ta ɓoye umarni a cikin aiki, ta kama ɗalibai 60 daga cikin 350 da ke amfani da AI ba tare da an gano su ta hanyar bincike na yau da kullum ba, kuma yanzu tana matsawa zuwa jarrabawar baka da muhawarar bidiyo maimakon rubutun kasidu; wani bincike na American Association of Colleges and Universities da Jami'ar Elon ya gano cewa kashi 95 cikin ɗari na malamai suna tsoron dogaro da ɗalibai kan AI fiye da kima.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, musamman tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, kuma wannan ja da baya daga software na gano AI a jami'o'i masu daraja alama ce kai tsaye kuma mai amfani ga yadda ƴungiyar ya kamata ta ba da shawara kan sake tsara tantancewa maimakon ganowa a matsayin amsar yin zagon ƙasa na AI.

AFP (via eNCA) · Established press (wire service report)

entry.title: Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026: Back to the Future
entry.summary:
Rahoton Kungiyar Kwadago ta Duniya, Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026, ya gano cewa adadin rashin aikin yi na matasa a duniya ya tashi zuwa kashi 12.4 cikin ɗari a shekarar 2025, wanda ya bar kusan matasa miliyan 67 masu shekaru 15 zuwa 24 ba su da aikin yi, yayin da kusan ɗaya cikin matasa biyar, kusan miliyan 257, ba su kasance cikin aikin yi, karatu, ko horo ba. Rahoton ya kiyasta cewa kashi 6.1 cikin ɗari na ayyukan da matasa masu shekaru 15 zuwa 29 ke yi suna cikin babban haɗarin maye gurbinsu da AI, galibi ayyukan ofis da na rubuce-rubuce da suka riga suka ragu ga matasa ma'aikata, kuma ya yi kira ga shugabanci na AI da fasaha mai mayar da hankali ga ɗan'adam, tare da ƙarin tallafi zuwa aikin yi mai daraja.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Samun aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wanda ya haɗa da yadda AI take canza ayyukan matakin farko, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD, kuma abin da wannan rahoto na gwamnatocin duniya ya gano, cewa ayyukan ofis, wanda sau da yawa shi ne mataki na farko ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu, suna cikin haɗari mafi girma ga AI, ya ba ƴungiyar ma'auni madogara kuma na duniya don aikinta kan AI da samun aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Kudancin Duniya.

International Labour Organization · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Generative AI use and misuse call for assessment reform in higher education
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da masana suka tantance a mujallar Science ya binciki ɗalibai sama da 95,000 a jami'o'i 20 manya na gwamnati na bincike a Amurka, a shekarar karatu ta 2023-24. Ya gano cewa kashi 37 cikin ɗari na ɗalibai suna amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki aƙalla sau ɗaya a wata don ayyukansu, kuma marubutan sun kiyasta cewa kusan kashi 9 cikin ɗari sun yi amfani da ita don yin zamba, adadin da ya tashi zuwa kashi 26 cikin ɗari a tsakanin masu amfani kullum; amfani da zamba sun bambanta sosai bisa fannin karatu. Marubutan suna kira da a yi gyare-gyaren tantancewa da suka dace da kowane fanni maimakon hani ɗaya tak ko tsarin ganowa na dukan jami'a.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, musamman tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, kuma abin da wannan babban bincike ya gano, cewa yin zagon ƙasa yana bambanta bisa fanni ba daidai ko'ina ba, ya ba ƙungiyar hujja madogara don tsara gyaren tantancewa na kowane fanni, maimakon gyara ɗaya tak.

Science · Peer-reviewed journal article
